morphology.formula: 按输入词基的部分重叠分析：patah → pa- + patah → pe- + patah → pepatah
morphology.pattern_note: 这里的 pe- 按首音节部分重叠理解，重叠音节的元音弱化为 /ə/，不是普通派生前缀。该分析用于说明词形，不等于已经证实唯一历史词源；可参照 [DBP 部分重叠说明](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/09/15/5030/)。

word_family.gloss: 折断；也用于计算话语单位
使折断者或物；亦有谚语义

senses.zh_definition: 凝练表达传统经验、劝诫或人生教益的谚语、格言。
senses.en_definition: A traditional proverb or saying expressing advice, wisdom, or a moral lesson.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis peribahasa yang mengandungi nasihat atau ajaran orang tua-tua; bidal.
senses.nuances: 属于 peribahasa 的范围，重点在劝诫和教益；不能把所有习语或新造口号都称为 pepatah。pepatah adat 特指涉及习俗规范的传统言辞；pepatah dan petitih 是并列固定表达，不构成另一种词性。[DBP 词条](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pepatah)支持这些用法。

collocations.zh: 习俗格言；传统习俗谚语

dual_scenarios.ms: Semangat kerjasama ini menepati pepatah Melayu, "Berat sama dipikul, ringan sama dijinjing."
dual_scenarios.zh: 这种合作精神体现了马来谚语“重担共同扛，轻担共同提”的道理。
dual_scenarios.en: This spirit of cooperation reflects the Malay proverb, "Heavy burdens are carried together, and light burdens are shared too."

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Simpan sikit-sikit je dulu. Ingat pepatah "Sedikit-sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit" tu.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Simpanlah wang sedikit demi sedikit dahulu. Ingatlah pepatah "Sedikit-sedikit, lama-lama menjadi bukit" itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 先一点一点存呗。记住那句谚语：“积少成多。”
dual_scenarios.en: Just save a little at a time. Remember the saying: "Little by little, it adds up."
spoken_features: sikit-sikit 对应 sedikit demi sedikit；je 对应 sahaja。
lah 在回应中加强认同；dah 对应 sudah。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Betul lah. Aku dah mula simpan lima ringgit sehari.
messages.ms_standard: Betul. Saya sudah mula menyimpan lima ringgit sehari.
messages.zh: 也是。我已经开始每天存五令吉了。
messages.en: True. I've already started saving five ringgit a day.

etymology.historical_story: Pepatah carries advice in a form people can remember and pass on. DBP describes it as a proverb containing elders' teachings and recognises pepatah adat for customary sayings. Its connection with patah offers a useful morphological reading, but should not be turned into an invented origin story. The cultural thread is concise language preserving shared practical wisdom.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pepatah 想成“一小截话，装着一大段智慧”：听见 pepatah，就想到长辈留下的谚语。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 引用谚语可使劝告显得含蓄，但当面用教训式谚语评价长辈、上司或失误者，仍可能让人难堪。宜把重点放在共同处境，例如 sama-sama kita ingat pepatah…。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合致辞、作文、文化交流及朋友间的鼓励。引用时保留公认措辞并确保寓意切题；涉及 pepatah adat 时，应尊重具体社群的习俗背景，避免把一句格言说成所有马来社群共同遵守的规定。
